AMBIENTFX.Behavior.FIELDS.src.label: Effect File
AMBIENTFX.Behavior.FIELDS.src.hint: Choose an image or video texture. Transparent WebM files work especially well for atmospheric effects.
AMBIENTFX.Behavior.FIELDS.opacity.label: Opacity
AMBIENTFX.Behavior.FIELDS.opacity.hint: How transparent the effect is. 0 is invisible and 1 is fully opaque.
AMBIENTFX.Behavior.FIELDS.scale.label: Scale
AMBIENTFX.Behavior.FIELDS.scale.hint: Scales the effect relative to the Region bounds. 1 fills the Region bounds using the selected Fit Mode.
AMBIENTFX.Behavior.FIELDS.fit.label: Fit Mode
AMBIENTFX.Behavior.FIELDS.fit.hint: Stretch fills the Region bounds exactly. Cover keeps the source aspect ratio and fills the bounds. Contain keeps the aspect ratio and fits entirely inside the bounds.
AMBIENTFX.Behavior.FIELDS.clipToRegion.h: When enabled, the visual is masked by the Region polygon instead of merely using its rectangular bounds.
